summary: sync must enumerate profiles and fan out to parent-scoped resources; a flat-path syncer can reach nothing on this API.
reason: Every Tiimo resource except /api/profiles lives under /api/profiles/{profile_id}/..., so a syncer that only resolves flat paths hydrates nothing and silently empties every offline command.
validated_outcome: Cold sync mirrors 1190 activity occurrences, 13 to-dos, 14 tags, 2 calendars where the generated syncer mirrored 1 profile and nothing else.
